name: Muscat de Saint-Jean-de-Minervois
terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation for vin doux naturel, a fortified sweet wine, made from white Muscat à Petits Grains. It comes from a single commune, Saint-Jean-de-Minervois, in Hérault.
